page: Microsoft Azure NV24s_v2 is a virtual server within the NVSv2 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system features 24 dedicated Intel vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture. It is configured with 448.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a high memory density of 18.67 GB of RAM per core.

The hardware profile includes two integrated GPUs and 3019 GB of local SSD storage. The server is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk attachments, though it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This server represents a high-density hardware class, combining dual GPUs with a large memory footprint and substantial local storage. It is designed for workloads that require parallel GPU processing, large-scale database operations, and memory-intensive analytical tasks.
